children: Bitcoin on-chain analyst Willy Woo said the current trend still appears to have room to run over the next 2-4 weeks before entering overbought territory and needing to cool. According to ChainCatcher, he added that if the oscillation indicator cools from late August to mid-September while prices remain strong, it would suggest buying demand is outweighing short-term profit takers.

title: Willy Woo Says Bitcoin Rally Has Room for 2-4 More Weeks Before Cooling
